Private Next 15.5.27 ESLint compatibility fork, 15.5.27-oday.1.

All upstream rules, configs and plugin exports retain their original bytes.
The directory traversal helper uses the preserved fast-glob 3.3.1 traversal
implementation with picomatch 2.3.2 scan/regex semantics. Brace expansion uses
brace-expansion 2.1.7; the known vulnerable braces compile/expand walkers are
excluded. The retained iterative parser supplies compatibility range checks;
its stringify helper also walks iteratively.

The fork includes the upstream Next, fast-glob and retained parser MIT
copyright notices. UPSTREAM.json records source hashes and provenance.
This is a local private fork, not a claimed upstream patched release.
Prior compatibility and audit results are historical candidate evidence;
current monorepo install, lint, regression and audit validation is required.
Release, license exceptions and security waivers are not approved here.
